summary: Founder sameAs page on the firm's own site returns 404; the third-party profile is off-host and not checked.
note: Not detected since rule set 2026.11.1: URL-004 checks images and files only, and an own-host sameAs link is a page, so a 404 there is not reported as a broken image (review reply, 2 November 2026). Detecting it needs a link rule, which is a contract change. The x.com 404 is outside v1 scope: requests go to the site's own host only (contract section 4).
